title: Institute of Chemical Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences Teams Up with iFLYTEK and Alibaba Cloud to Launch 3.0 Pro
excerpt: Recently, the intelligent chemical industry large model 3.0 Pro, jointly developed by the Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics of the Chinese Academy of Science
content_html:
Recently, the intelligent chemical industry large model 3.0 Pro, jointly developed by the Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, iFLYTEK, and Alibaba Cloud, was officially unveiled. As the latest iteration of the first large model in China's chemical industry, the release of this system marks that industry large models are moving away from the single knowledge Q&A era and taking a crucial step towards deeper industrial applications.

In terms of technological advancement, 3.0 Pro has made a leap from traditional modes to a new stage. In the past, industry large models mainly focused on information retrieval and content generation, playing the role of "being able to understand and answer." However, the 3.0 Pro released this time further breaks through boundaries, evolving towards a deep application model of "being able to plan, execute, and verify." This upgrade in architecture and functionality promotes artificial intelligence in the chemical industry from a simple knowledge acquisition tool to an intelligent engineering partner with practical capabilities.

The deep joint R&D by multiple institutions not only gathers top-level scientific research capabilities and cloud computing resources but also provides a more solid foundational support for the intelligent transformation of the chemical industry. With the official launch of 3.0 Pro, artificial intelligence will demonstrate even broader application potential and commercial value in scenarios such as complex chemical process planning, production process optimization, and data verification in the future.
